executiveSummary.narrative:
NOW NOW NOHO appeared in at least one AI answer for 12.7% of the traveler needs we tested, and across every individual AI answer it appeared 3.2% of the time. Together, these results show how broadly AI recognizes the hotel and how consistently a traveler would encounter it.

AI currently reflects 25% of the monitored facts and attributes that define the hotel, so important parts of the property proposition are not consistently represented in AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.

writeup.title: WHAT THE DATA SAYS
writeup.body:
NOW NOW NOHO appeared in at least one AI answer for 12.7% of the traveler needs we tested, and across every individual AI answer it appeared 3.2% of the time. Together, these results show how broadly AI recognizes the hotel and how consistently a traveler would encounter it.

AI currently reflects 25% of the monitored facts and attributes that define the hotel, so important parts of the property proposition are not consistently represented in AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.

sections.headline: NOW NOW NOHO's primary issue is entering AI consideration at all, especially for Couples / Romantic Stay.
sections.keyInsight: AI Consideration is 3.2%, so the hotel appears in only a limited share of individual comparable responses. When the hotel is absent, Crosby Street Hotel repeatedly appears instead — a concentrated substitution pattern rather than a diffuse competitor list. Rank tactics have limited value until relevance improves. The binding constraint is becoming part of the answer set for the traveler needs the hotel currently misses.
sections.whyItMatters: Fine-tuning rank against individual competitors will have limited value until the hotel becomes relevant in more of the traveler needs it currently misses. Entry problems and rank problems require different management attention. If leadership optimizes competitor comparisons first, the hotel can look busy while still missing the larger answer-set gap.
sections.focusNow: Focus first on how the hotel is represented for Couples / Romantic Stay. Review whether the attributes, positioning, and use cases most relevant to those travelers are complete and consistently represented across priority sources. Treat competitor-rank tactics as secondary until entry improves.
sections.whatToReview: Compare evidence from scenarios where Crosby Street Hotel appears with the property information currently available for NOW NOW NOHO. Check entry cues first — product type, occasion, and location framing — before broadening the review to secondary attributes.
